Booked through them for my brother’s wedding at Holiday Inn Mumbai International Airport in April, and unfortunately, the experience was far from professional.

Our biggest issue was with the promises made during the sales process. Several things were verbally committed by the sales SPOC, and when we asked for them to be included in the agreement, we were told to trust him. In hindsight, we should have insisted that every detail be properly documented.

Soon after the contract was signed, that SPOC was apparently no longer with the company, and a new person took over our account with little to no understanding of what had been discussed. We found ourselves having to explain and negotiate everything all over again. Even after sharing messages and handwritten notes from our discussions, many commitments were disputed or ignored.

One example was the hi-tea arrangement. It was explicitly mentioned in the contract, yet on the wedding day nothing had been organized. When we raised it, we were casually told that it had been “forgotten” and there had been an oversight. Guests had arrived, events were underway, and even by 6:30 PM there was still no hi-tea in place. This is not the kind of lapse you expect during a wedding and this is just one example. I haven’t even touched upon how the check-in process was handled or the confusion and last-minute scrambling around licenses and permissions, because that alone would take up the rest of this review.
The overall experience felt reactive rather than professional, and we often found ourselves chasing answers instead of receiving support.

To be fair, our experience with Holiday Inn itself was great. I had myself skipping this layer & directly speaking with the hotel staff who were very courteous & helpful.
The challenge was having this company as the middle layer. Communication was poor, accountability was lacking, and we ended up spending far too much time managing issues ourselves.

For anyone considering them because of pricing advantages, please do your homework. There was no meaningful financial benefit as well because you are paying these folks directly. The hotels might offer better deals than them. We found that the perceived savings and added services simply didn’t justify the additional complications.

My honest advice is to deal directly with the hotel and hire a professional wedding or event planner if required. Based on our experience, having them involved created more stress than value.
